help.title: A question?
help.text: Write to us and we will answer the address you write from.

withdrawalCta.title: Want to withdraw from a purchase?
withdrawalCta.text: Fill in the short form and get an email confirmation straight away. No account needed.

meta.title: Withdraw from the contract
meta.description: An online form to withdraw from a contract made in the shop: fill it in and get an email confirmation.

withdrawal.title: Withdraw from the contract here
withdrawal.lead: Fill in the form to tell us you withdraw from an order or part of it. We email you a confirmation straight away, with the text of your statement and the date and time you sent it.
rulesList: You have 14 days from receiving the goods, and for services from the conclusion of the contract.
Return the goods within 14 days of telling us. You bear the cost of returning them.
We refund within 14 days, by the same means you paid.

fields.name: Full name
fields.orderHint: For example 8E04FC85: it is in the order email and in your account.
fields.receivedHint: If you have already received the goods.
fields.noteHint: Optional. You do not need to give a reason.

withdrawal.privacy: We use these details only to process the withdrawal. More in the
withdrawal.statement: I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract.
withdrawal.statementPart: I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract as regards the products or services listed.

errors.name: Write your name.
errors.email: Write an email address for the confirmation.
errors.items: Write which products or services you withdraw from.
errors.tooFast: The form was sent too quickly. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.failed: We could not record the statement. Try again or email us at {email}: an email is a valid withdrawal too.

success.title: We received your withdrawal
success.text: Your statement was sent on {date} at {time}. We emailed a confirmation to {email}, and will write about returning the goods and the refund.

withdrawal.subject: Withdrawal from the contract — order #{order}

ack.body: we confirm we received your withdrawal from the contract on {date} at {time}. We will write with instructions for the return and the refund.
ack.replyHint: If you have a question, just reply to this email.
